### Create Conditional Probability Tables (CPT

```{r Disturbance_CPT}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

#urban_prox_cpt<-matrix(c(0,0,0), ncol=3, dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))
#road_density_cpt<-matrix(c(0,0,0), ncol=3, dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))
#connectivity_cpt<-matrix(c(0,0,0),ncol = 3,dimnames = list(NULL, c("LOW", "MED","HIGH")))

#disturb_index_cpt<-c(rep(0,81))#3^4

#dim(disturb_index_cpt) = c(3, 3, 3, 3)

#dimnames(disturb_index_cpt) = list("disturb_index" = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"), "urban_prox" =  c("LOW","MED", "HIGH"),"road_density" = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"),"connectivity"=c("LOW","MED","HIGH"))

disturb_index_cpt <- array(
  0,  # Default probability for each cell
  dim = c(3, 3, 3, 3),  # Shape of the array (3x3x3)
  dimnames = list(
    disturb_index = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"),
    road_density = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH"),
    urban_prox = c("LOW","MED","HIGH"),
    connectivity = c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
  )
)
#order = disturb_index, road_density, urban_prox,connectivity
#table1: urban_prox = LOW, connectivity = LOW
disturb_index_cpt["LOW","LOW","LOW","LOW"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["MED","MED","LOW","LOW"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","HIGH","LOW","LOW"] <- 1
#table2:  urban_prox = MED, connectivity = LOW
disturb_index_cpt["MED","LOW","MED","LOW"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["MED","MED","MED","LOW"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","HIGH","MED","LOW"] <- 1
#table3: urban_prox = HIGH, connectivity = LOW
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","LOW","HIGH","LOW"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","MED","HIGH","LOW"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","HIGH","HIGH","LOW"] <- 1
#table4: urban_prox = LOW, connectivity = MED
disturb_index_cpt["LOW","LOW","LOW","MED"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["MED","MED","LOW","MED"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["MED","HIGH","LOW","MED"] <- 1
#table5: urban_prox = MED, connectivity = MED
disturb_index_cpt["LOW","LOW","MED","MED"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["MED","MED","MED","MED"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","HIGH","MED","MED"] <- 1
#table6: urban_prox = HIGH, connectivity = MED
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","LOW","HIGH","MED"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","MED","HIGH","MED"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","HIGH","HIGH","MED"] <- 1
#table7: urban_prox = LOW, connectivity = HIGH
disturb_index_cpt["LOW","LOW","LOW","HIGH"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["LOW","MED","LOW","HIGH"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["MED","HIGH","LOW","HIGH"] <- 1
#table8: urban_prox = MED, connectivity = HIGH
disturb_index_cpt["MED","LOW","MED","HIGH"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["MED","MED","MED","HIGH"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","HIGH","MED","HIGH"] <- 1
#table9: urban_prox = HIGH, connectivity = HIGH
disturb_index_cpt["MED","LOW","HIGH","HIGH"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["MED","MED","HIGH","HIGH"] <- 1
disturb_index_cpt["HIGH","HIGH","HIGH","HIGH"] <- 1

disturb_index_cpt

```

### Create BN Structure

```{r BN structure}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

net<-model2network("[urban_prox][road_density][linear_feature][woodland][patch_size][total_edge][shelter][disturb_index|urban_prox:road_density][nutritional|woodland:patch_size:total_edge][deer_damage|disturb_index:linear_feature:shelter:nutritional]") # You dont need to repeat the names of the nodes with parents (child nodes) 

# Custom fitting network (matching up the nodes to their CPTs)
dfit = custom.fit(net, dist = list(urban_prox = urban_prox_cpt, road_density = road_density_cpt,linear_feature = linear_feature_cpt, woodland=woodland_cpt,
                                   patch_size=patch_size_cpt, total_edge=total_edge_cpt, shelter=shelter_cpt, disturb_index=disturb_index_cpt,nutritional= nutritional_index_cpt,deer_damage= deer_damage_cpt))


```

```

```

### Set evidence

```{r set evidence}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
cpquery(dfit, c(total_edge == "LOW"|shelter == "LOW"|woodland=="BROADLEAVED"), (deer_damage=="HIGH"))

```

#### Test with the dummy data

```{r spatial data}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# need to do some cleaning of dummy data
dummy_BBN_spatial_data <- readRDS("C:/Users/ik929086/Documents/iDeer_Local/BBN_structure/inputs/dummy_BBN_spatial_data.RDS")
#convert to upper
dummy_BBN_spatial_data<-dummy_BBN_spatial_data |> 
 mutate(across(where(is.character), toupper))

dummy_BBN_spatial_data<-dummy_BBN_spatial_data |> 
  mutate(across(patch_size:damage, ~gsub("MEDIUM","MED",.)))
test_data<-dummy_BBN_spatial_data |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::select(patch_size:woodland)

test_data<-test_data |> 
  mutate_if(is.character, as.factor)

levels(test_data$patch_size)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$road_density)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$nutritional)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$urban_prox)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$total_edge)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$linear_feature)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")
levels(test_data$shelter)<-c("LOW", "MED", "HIGH")


```

#### Predict from the BN using the dummy data

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

test_data<-test_data
pred = predict(dfit, node = "disturb_index", data = test_data,method = "bayes-lw")

dummy_BBN_spatial_data$pred<-pred

```

#### Draw a nice map

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false

plot(dummy_BBN_spatial_data["pred"])

```
